comment: Great professor and person. Lectures well and can mold explanations to fit your understanding. Gives clear criteria tests and the level of depth you need to understand each topic (such as being able to recognize versus recall). Biochemistry is a challenging class; like Orgo, having a good professor like Dattlebaum makes it manageable.

I love Professor Dattelbaum. His class isn't the easiest but he teaches it well and is always ready to help if you have questions. Just know that the tests questions and homework problems are harder than the ones given in class. Overall, he is a great professor, and I thought he was really funny.

Dr. Dattelbaum is very friendly and empathetic towards his students. He is lecture heavy, although is pretty straightforward. With all that said, his tests (the majority of our grade) are very challenging. The problems on the test are significantly more difficult that any in-class or HW problems. Prepare a LONG time in advance for tests. good luck.

I took this class for the science general education requirement. CHEM141 with Dr. D was not easy, but if you are interested in the subject then I highly recommend this teacher. He prepares you for future classes and is very fair with his grading. He wants his students to succeed. If you apply yourself, a high grade in this class is very possible.

i love this man! ive never been a chem girl but he made me one. literally almost failed chemistry in hs and now im doing good. he explains like the way an elementary school would, slow and repetitive. won't say his tests are easy, but if you study, you'll do well, the class averages are p high. he's so nice and would never hurt a fly!

He is an effective chemistry teacher that cares about his students. His practice of asking a lot of straightforward questions to his students was helpful in keeping me engaged. He holds review sessions for his tests the day before (even at night and on Sunday) that were helpful in doing well. I appreciate that he was receptive to the many Q I asked
Excellent professor. He is very patient and willing to answer all 500 questions he gets asked each lab! Only complaint was that feedback on work was minimal. I would highly recommend Dr. Dattelbaum.

Dr. Dattlebaum is such a peach! He is always happy, and always available for extra help. He teaches clearly and succinctly, and if you pay attention and do the homework, your grade should be fine. By far one of my best experiences in the Chemistry department at UR

Dr. D is fantastic. I would take him for all my chemistry classes if I could. His lectures are clear and organized, even though no powerpoint is used. (Take notes in class!) Clear responses when answering questions. Helpful after class and during office hours. Has funny anecdotes. Tests are straightforward and fair, nothing tricky.
Best option as a Chem 141 teacher. Willing to help you after class. Homework can be difficult but he is more than willing to help you out. Really engaging in class.

Very difficult tests. Good professor and always smiling, but assigns a community-based learning project which is completely irrelevant to the course and a colossal waste of time in a course for which time is of the absolute essence. Make sure you have the time to commit to this class or you are hopping aboard a sinking ship. Good prof., hard class.

I had Dr. D for chem 141 lab. He's a really, really nice guy, but a little bit of a hard grader. I did fine in lab, but he would take points off and not explain why, or not explain what to do to make a lab report right. He joked around with my lab partner and I, which made lab fun, but he didn't seem to act that way with many other people. Great gu

Dr. D is a great guy. I know of a few people who did not like his lecturing style, but I loved class and found him to be thorough and complete with his explanations and responses to questions. He is really one of the best Professors in the Chemistry Department.

Dr. D is a really  nice person but is a very poor lecturer and exam writer. He has never answered an in-class question satisfactorily and is often incomprehensible. Also, the community based learning project required for class does not have anything to do with biochem and, therefore, is ridiculous!

I am by no means a chem major but I still loved this class because of Dr. D!  He adds so much personality to the subject, explains the concepts so clearly, and really cares for every student. If you are going to take chem 141, definitely take it with him!
Favorite professor from first semester
Great, great guy. He is very friendly and mnore than welcome to help beyond the classroom. He is an excellent professor and teaches well.
Dr. D is a fantastic teacher- very eager to help and explain the concepts clearly. Plus, he is precious! Very cheerful and just a really nice guy. Highly recommend even if chem isn't your thing.

Dr. D is the man. He's friendly, patient, and mildly humourous. He's also a good teacher who has a very positive attitude. Personally, I didn't think his class was hard at all. I also liked how flexible he was in allowing me to take the final on a different day than it was scheduled for.

Dr. Dattelbaum is awesome. He is really chill about work, willing to make accomodations whenever necessary and is very helpful both in and outside of class. He even let me take the final a different day from everyone else because I had bio the day it was scheduled. Really a great guy with a goofy, genuine sense of humor.

one of the best teachers i've ever had, very easy to meet to discuss questions, etc.   very clear explanations, very helpful outside of class.  difficult tests that carry a lot of weight.  great lab instructor.

D-bomb...He is a great guy who knows not only chem, but all sciences.  Ask him to tell a story before class, gets you in the mood for chem.  Tests can be a little tricky, but doing problems in book or his little quizzes helps.  Definitely recommend...However, pay attention.  He'll ask you "So...what's chemistry ?" and you will completely freeze!

He's a nice guy and very enthusiastic about chemistry.  He also looks like a comedian named Jeremy Hotz.  He likes making little chemistry jokes, but they are entertaining.  He explains everything in a very open and simple manner and he is considerate about events out of our control.  I'd definitely recommend him.
